cnpcplus.configuration.title: CNPCPlus Config
cnpcplus.configuration.dialogTextColor.t: Base RGB color for dialog text.
Default & format prefix for dialog text.
cnpcplus.configuration.dialogOptionColor: Base RGB color for dialog options.
cnpcplus.configuration.dialogOptionForma: Default & format prefix for dialog options.
cnpcplus.configuration.recipeFuzzyMatchR:
Format: itemId|nbtField1,nbtField2;itemId|
Used when a recipe has Config Fuzzy enabled.
cnpcplus.configuration.craftingViewEnabl:
Shows/hides the recipe sidebar (crafting view) on workbench and carpentry bench.
Default true; false hides the sidebar.
Hot-reload: takes effect immediately after saving, no restart needed.
Enabled by default. NPC names are hidden behind entities and blocks when enabled.
cnpcplus.configuration.bardVolume.toolti:
Volume multiplier for bard music/jukebox (default 1.0, 0.0-1.0).
Independent from the game's Music and Jukebox/Note Block volumes.
cnpcplus.configuration.bardWatchdogSecon: Force-switch songs that fail to end within this many seconds (default 300 = 5 min).
cnpcplus.smelting.title: Custom Smelting Recipes
cnpcplus.smelting.name: Recipe Name
cnpcplus.configuration.returnToStartTime: Teleport to start if the NPC still hasn't arrived after this many seconds (default 30).
cnpcplus.configuration.returnToStartSmoo:
Fixes NPCs repeatedly stalling, teleporting or jumping right before reaching their start point (default on).
Turn off to restore vanilla behavior for comparison.
cnpcplus.configuration.returnToStartArri:
Horizontal distance considered arrived at the start point (default 3.0, range 0.5-32).
Vanilla's ±0.2 is below pathfinding accuracy, so NPCs were misjudged as stuck and jittered/teleported; 3 blocks covers "path done but one or two steps short".
cnpcplus.configuration.corpseNoCollision: Respawning NPCs' corpses no longer block movement, crosshair or projectiles (default on). Restored on respawn.
cnpcplus.configuration.smeltingGuiOffset: Overall X offset of the custom smelting recipe GUI (default 0, range -300~300).
Overall Y offset of the custom smelting recipe GUI (default 20, same as 1.20.1, range -300~300).
NPCs' vanilla armor reduces damage by the vanilla formula and loses 1 durability per 4 damage (default off).
Off = vanilla-like: armor is stored but has no effect (companions with role 6 keep their own algorithm).
Fall/void BYPASSES_ARMOR damage is unaffected; changes apply immediately.
cnpcplus.configuration.realArmorOverride:
Companions use their own (25-armor)/25 simplified armor formula (default off).
false = keep companion formula; true = companions also use real armor.
cnpcplus.configuration.shadowRadiusMax.t:
Affects shadow size only; models, hitboxes, damage and animations are untouched (default 999 = vanilla size).
Lower it if giant NPCs' shadows tank the framerate; 0 disables shadows entirely.
cnpcplus.configuration.outlineCacheEnabl:
Share CNPC's vanilla-generated 2D outlines to avoid regenerating them (default on).
Off = vanilla instance cache; F3+T reload still clears VRAM caches.
cnpcplus.configuration.outlineCacheEntri:
Max shared outline entries (not NPC count; default 2048, range 64-16384).
Least-recently-used entries are evicted and regenerated on demand.
cnpcplus.configuration.blueprintCacheEna:
Cache builder-blueprint previews to skip per-frame rebuilds (default on).
Preview only; actual building is unaffected. Turn off to fall back to CNPC's original preview renderer for compatibility checks.
cnpcplus.configuration.blueprintBudgetMi:
Soft per-frame time budget for building previews (default 2, range 0.25-20).
Lower = less hitching but slower full preview; never removes preview blocks.
cnpcplus.configuration.blueprintMaxBlock:
Max preview blocks processed per frame, combined with the time budget; includes air (default 2048, range 16-8192).
Work continues next frame; nothing is truncated and build speed is unchanged.
